ai.summary: OpenAI reportedly plans to buy Google’s Tensor Processing Units, according to a report cited by Reuters. The potential purchase would diversify OpenAI’s computing supply beyond Nvidia, though financial and other deal details have not been disclosed.
ai.title: OpenAI plans to buy Google’s AI chips, The Information reports

ai.summary: Oracle is broadening its AI chip offerings: it plans to make Google TPUs available through its cloud in 2027 and add chips from Cerebras and SambaNova, alongside an expanded Nvidia commitment. The move gives cloud customers more options for AI workloads, particularly inference.
ai.title: Oracle expands chip supply deal with Nvidia, adds Google and Cerebras offerings

ai.summary: OpenAI says its AI systems produced results in mathematics, computer science and physics, including an algorithm it says challenges the Exponential Time Hypothesis. The claims are consequential but remain subject to scrutiny and independent verification by researchers.
ai.title: AI refutes 30-year-old mathematical assumption in computer science

ai.summary: OpenAI announced three claimed breakthroughs spanning mathematics, computer science and physics, but its release of supporting material varies by result. The company has released the mathematical output, while it says researchers will help explain the computer-science finding and physics material is not yet available.
ai.title: Researchers are getting tired of OpenAI gatekeeping its breakthroughs

ai.summary: Anthropic says Claude identified 493 flaws across 25 open-source projects in a review effort. The finding highlights both the potential of AI tools to assist security audits and the need for maintainers to validate and address reported issues.
ai.title: Anthropic set Claude on 25 open-source projects and it found 493 flaws

quantum.summary: IBM connected two 120-qubit processors using superconducting links, reporting 99% average fidelity for transferring quantum states between chips. The team also demonstrated remote gates and entanglement; the work is still at the pre-peer-review stage.
quantum.title: IBM Connects Two 120-Qubit Processors With 99% State-Transfer Fidelity

quantum.summary: Quantinuum reported 99.9995% logical fidelity on its Helios system, describing roughly five lost protected-information events per million error-correction rounds. The result concerns logical memory performance, not the accuracy of arbitrary full computations.
quantum.title: Quantinuum Hits 99.9995% Logical Fidelity on Helios

quantum.summary: Intel’s planned Classiq acquisition would pair Intel’s quantum hardware and manufacturing work with Classiq’s software for designing quantum algorithms. The reported $2.3 billion price has not been officially disclosed by Intel; the deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to approvals.
quantum.title: Intel’s Classiq Deal May Signal a Pivot From Quiet Quantum Effort To Active Commercialization

quantum.summary: Quantum Elements and Qarakal Quantum announced a $2.4 million BIRD Foundation-backed project to develop a quantum simulation platform for catalyst research. The work will combine superconducting hardware with software and AI-based tools for co-design and error handling.
quantum.title: Quantum Elements and Qarakal Quantum Receive BIRD Foundation Grant for Quantum Computing Innovation with a $2.4M Budget

quantum.summary: A report highlighted quantum-error-correction researcher Barbara Terhal’s appointment as QuSoft’s 2026 Turing Chair and a workshop in Amsterdam running October 28–30. Terhal’s work focuses on the boundary between quantum hardware, software, and error-correcting codes.
quantum.title: Barbara Terhal’s Quantum Return To Amsterdam As QuSoft’s 2026 Turing Chair

quantum.summary: Intel’s proposed purchase of Classiq is a significant industry move toward combining quantum-computing hardware and software under one company. The companies say Classiq’s existing software integrations with other hardware platforms are expected to continue after the acquisition.
quantum.title: Intel to Acquire Classiq to Build Full-Stack Quantum Computing Platform
